name: Shadowfax
source: Read through a browser: the public page https://www.shadowfax.in/track looks the number up with its own token, and its own call GET saruman.shadowfax.in/web_app/delivery/track/<awb>/ was recorded 2026-10-29 (tests/fixtures/shadowfax_track.json). That endpoint answers 401 to a plain request, so there is no direct layer, and no token is copied. Only one status group (one scan) was seen, so a group holding several sub-events is read as its first one only, and only 'Delivery Attempt Unsucessful' (their spelling) is a seen status; Delivered and Out for delivery are unverified guesses. Times have no timezone; Indian Standard Time matches the page.
